messages:
rachel: Heads-up from the postmortem: disk-io-high on db-shard-7 created ~150 pages over the weekend. PM traced to backup window + noisy SMART check flaps. Need action items to reduce pages and own remediation. Short plan below.

tom: I'll take tuning. Plan: (1) move static threshold -> short-term baseline (last 10m median + 4 sigma) for io_wait, (2) add a transient suppression during scheduled backups to avoid expected spikes. ETA: Tue EOD sim results.

divya: I'll own dedupe. Proposal: key on host_id:metric and use "collapse_and_report" mode with a 120s window to collapse rapid repeats into one page with count. That keeps signal but reduces churn.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-20260322-DIO  triggered 149 times. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/disk-io-high

sam: Ops note: change paging policy to require 2 sustained occurrences within a 5m sliding window before paging; single instantaneous spikes become warnings. Also prefer sending aggregated payload with count+example samples.

rachel: Good. Please add explicit rollback commands for each config change and fallback tests in the runbook.

tom: snippet for baseline threshold algorithm (draft):
```
baseline = median(last_10m)
threshold = baseline + 4*std(last_10m)
if io_wait > threshold for 30s -> alert
```
I'll include sim numbers.

divya: dedupe config draft:
```
dedupe_key: "host_id:metric"
window_sec: 120
mode: "collapse_and_report"
```
Agree with aggregated payload.

sam: Canary plan: 15% of pages on Mon 01:00 UTC for 36h. Ops will monitor missed-detection via synthetic workload. If missed-detection > 3% -> rollback.

rachel: Owners & deadlines recap:
- Baseline threshold sims + recommendation 1 tom 1 Tue EOD
- Dedupe config + rollback doc 1 divya 1 Wed 12:00
- Paging policy change canary 1 sam 1 Mon 01:00 UTC (15%, 36h)
- Runbook edits (alert examples + rollback steps) 1 rachel/tom/divya 1 Fri EOD

tom: rollback cmd (thresholds):
```
./deploy-alerts.sh --env prod --set threshold_mode=static
```
I'll add automated test that fires a synthetic spike to validate detection.

divya: rollback cmd (dedupe):
```
kubectl apply -f alerting/dedupe/disable-collapse.yaml
```
I'll add the test harness link to the runbook.

oncall-bot: PM tracker updated: https://redwood.internal/pm-tracker/PM-20260322
\rsachel: small ask: measure pages/day, sustained-pages, aggregate-collapse-rate, missed-detect-rate for 30 days post-change. If we see >=2 repeats, escalate to eng-sre for deep investigation.

sam: Canary scheduled and roster updated. Will post canary dashboard link in here when live.

tom: starting sims now, will post numbers and the false-positive / detection latency table.

divya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/alerting/pulls/77 1 comments welcome.

rachel: Thanks all. Follow-up meeting Fri 09:00 UTC to review canary metrics (rachel, tom, divya, sam).
